cohort: The study included 149 neonates with suspected early-onset sepsis, 67 neonates with proven early-onset sepsis, and 92 healthy neonates born at Izmir Buca Maternity and Pediatric Hospital between March 2015 and February 2016.
finding: The study found that PLR values were significantly higher in neonates with suspected or proven early-onset sepsis compared to healthy controls, suggesting that PLR could be a useful predictor of neonatal sepsis.
